app.storage.title: Quarantine & Journal
c09.title: Duplicate files
c09.subtitle: Preview first, then apply — undoable, with logs.
c09.params.title: Scan & cleanup parameters
c09.params.sub: Leave the quick window empty to use the two-phase size → full pass; fill it in to enable three phases.
c09.root.label: Scan directory
c09.keep.label: Keep policy
c09.quick.label: Quick hash window (bytes)
c09.protected.label: Protected directories (one per line, optional)
c09.protected.hint: S02 protected directories are marked blocked at plan time and re-checked at apply time; matching files are never moved.
c09.plan.hint: Scan only, no writes; every entry can be reviewed after the plan is generated.
c09.preview.title: Plan preview
c09.preview.sub: Every row is a file that will be moved to quarantine; blocked entries are never executed.
c09.preview.empty: Enter a scan directory and generate a plan to see duplicate groups and cleanup entries here.
c09.execute.title: Apply
c09.execute.sub: Removal only moves files to quarantine; review the preview before confirming.
c09.execute.confirm: I reviewed the preview and confirm moving {count} files to quarantine
c09.execute.blockedHint: Some entries are blocked; they are skipped at apply time and protected directories are never touched.
c09.execute.windowHint: The undo window is 7 days by default; past it, run retention cleanup first.
c09.stale: Parameters changed, the previous preview is stale: generate a new plan before applying.
c09.danger.title: Protected directories matched
c09.danger.body: {count} entries in this plan fall inside protected directories. They are forbidden to write and will not run (enforcement lives in the kernel executor; this confirmation does not change it). The remaining entries will still run — continue?
c09.cleanup.title: Retention cleanup
c09.cleanup.sub: Dry run by default; expired quarantine files and Journal records are only removed after you opt into permanent deletion.
c09.cleanup.hintDry: Dry run; no files are deleted.
c09.result.title: Results
c09.result.sub: Results come only from the engine report; nothing is handled silently.
c09.result.empty: Per-entry results appear after a run.
c09.about.title: Current form
c09.about.sub: Desktop shell: local file system; zero licensing enforcement in web/shell.
c09.about.hint: Apply and undo run through the desktop task queue; progress, pause, cancel and terminal states arrive via task:// events.
c09.notice.planDone: Plan generated: {count} entries to clean up, {blocked} blocked. Review the preview before applying.
c09.notice.queued: Task queued; progress and results arrive via task:// events.
c09.notice.undoQueued: Undo task queued; rollback progress arrives via task:// events.
c09.notice.retryQueued: Retry task queued; only failed entries re-run, completed ones are skipped via Journal idempotency.
c09.notice.cancelUndo: Undoing the {count} entries completed before cancellation; rollback progress arrives via task:// events.
c09.notice.cleanupDry: Cleanup dry run finished; no files were deleted. Permanent deletion only happens when you opt in.
c09.notice.cleanupDone: Cleanup finished: removed {entries} Journal records and {files} quarantine files.
c09.notice.recoverResume: Interrupted task resumed; completed entries are skipped via Journal idempotency.
c09.notice.recoverRollback: Interrupted task rolled back from the Journal; the rollback task is queued.
c09.notice.recoverDiscard: Recovery discarded; applied entries can still be undone from the Journal.
c09.recover.title: Interrupted task detected
c09.recover.body: The app exited unexpectedly last time. Choose resume, rollback or discard; nothing runs automatically.
c09.error.quickWindow: The quick hash window must be a positive integer (leave empty to skip)
c09.error.stale: Parameters changed, the previous preview is stale: generate a new plan before applying
c09.error.staleDetail: Parameters changed during preflight; no write was dispatched (zero side effects)
c09.error.diskBlocked: Preflight blocked: not enough disk space, the task did not run (zero side effects)
c09.preflight.blocked: Not enough disk space: apply is blocked, the task has zero side effects.
c09.cancelReview.title: {count} entries completed — undo them as well?
c09.cancelReview.body: Cancellation stopped the remaining entries; these {count} entries are already written to disk and recorded in the Journal. Undo restores them in reverse order (deleted files come back from quarantine, overwritten files from backups); keeping them leaves undo available in the task panel.
feature.subtitle: Preview first, then apply, undoable (C18 dry run: the plan command writes nothing).
feature.plan.hint: The plan command is a dry-run preview (C18): zero writes, repeated previews are idempotent.
feature.plan.empty: Fill in the parameters and generate a plan to see the per-entry preview here.
feature.preview.title: Plan preview
feature.execute.title: Apply & undo
feature.execute.sub: C06: dry-run rollback before undo; rollback is terminal.
feature.execute.done: Apply finished; use Undo to restore (rollback is terminal and cannot be rolled back twice).
feature.dryRun.title: Rollback dry run
feature.c05.title: C05 preview & conflict detection
feature.stale: Parameters changed, the previous preview is stale: generate a new plan before applying.
feature.form.title: Runtime form
feature.form.web: Browser preview · mock IPC (no real plan)
feature.notice.planDone: Plan generated: {count} entries. Review the preview before applying.
feature.notice.queued: Task queued; progress arrives via task:// events.
feature.notice.undoQueued: Undo task queued; rollback progress arrives via task:// events.
feature.notice.cancelRequested: Cancellation requested: it stops at the current entry boundary and rolls back completed entries.
feature.notice.retryQueued: Retry task queued (a new taskId references the same planId; only failed entries re-run).
feature.field.sourceColumnName: Source column name (empty = no source column)
feature.field.columns: Column names (comma separated, in selection order)
feature.field.keyColumns: Key column names (comma separated, empty = whole row)
feature.field.mergeColumns: Merge source columns (comma separated, excludes split)
feature.field.rules: Rule chain (one <subdir>|<type>:<params> per line, first match wins)
feature.field.sources: Compression sources (one path per line, compress mode)
feature.field.f10.hint: UTF-8 BOM CSV with columns: relative path / name / type / size / modified time / depth; file contents are never read.
feature.field.c08.hint: Four condition types: ext / mtime(from..to) / size(bytes min..max) / name keyword; unmatched files stay in place.
feature.field.f11.hint: Paths are relative to the target root; .. escapes are rejected (E1003).
tasks.title: Tasks & undo
tasks.summary: {total} tasks · {active} in progress · undo goes through the shared Journal; rollback is terminal.
tasks.empty: No task records yet. Generate a preview on Data cleanup or any feature page and apply it — the task shows up here.
tasks.notice.resumed: Resume submitted; progress appears in the task panel above.
tasks.notice.cancel: Cancellation submitted; entries not yet written will not run.
tasks.notice.retry: Retry submitted; only failed entries re-run.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: User settings go only into ConfigDocument; window and layout belong to local UI state and are not here.
settings.readonly: The config file was written by a newer version and is read-only here: viewable but not editable.
settings.scope.general.hint: Language, theme, default output location, launch behavior.
settings.scope.processing.hint: Encoding policy, line endings, conflict policy, backup retention.
settings.scope.performance.hint: Concurrency, memory budget, large-file threshold; all support Auto.
settings.scope.security.hint: Protected directories, quarantine location and retention, placeholder policy.
settings.scope.logging.hint: Operation log retention days, whether to record full paths.
settings.autoHint: Leave empty or type auto to use the baseline value.
settings.hint.language: Switching applies immediately and writes general.language; open tasks keep the wording they were created with.
settings.hint.theme: Light is the default; Follow system tracks the OS appearance.
settings.hint.outputDir: Empty means ask every time — no write location is preselected (safe default).
settings.hint.protectedDirs: Subtree semantics; matches are blocked at plan time and re-checked at apply time.
settings.hint.retention: Same basis as the undo window; numeric ranges follow the baseline.
settings.hint.logFullPaths: Full paths are not recorded by default (privacy-conservative).
settings.webNote: The browser form does not promise config persistence; exporting recipes is the only cross-form migration path.
